args: Implement docs/plans/one-build-correct-citations-plan.md using existing data only: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 find why the Greater Bengaluru view is stale, build the city and all corporation views in one step from one dataset, add shared-content and same-build checks in CI, and verify the Greater Bengaluru Setbacks page after deploy; Part 2 make every amended provision cite the amending instrument's page where its wording appears, with a CI check that every quote and table row is found on its cited page; Part 3 take every instrument's name and date from the source register, resolve the "20 January 2026" label, and add a name check in CI; Part 4 record applicability clauses such as 3.1(ii) and 3.1(iii) and show "not settled" only when no in-force clause decides, explaining the setbacks height case in one line; Part 5 show each corporation's current wording for bye-law 6.0(i) and allow the "Master plan rules apply instead" label only on bye-law 1.4 subjects, with a CI check; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md current and the PR's "For owner review", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections up to date; never invent or rewrite legal text.
